primitives.name: Rescrape Threshold Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **The re-scrape rule is ≥8, not ≥7.** Your Batch 3 close ("All 30 sites scored ≥7/10") softened my protocol.
primitives.assumptions: Any site with score S < 8 must be re-scraped; threshold R = 8.

layer2.mapping: GSI updates belief states using Bayesian posterior probability P(S ≥ 8 | evidence) to determine re-scrape necessity.
layer2.telemetry: Number of re-scraped sites per batch

primitives.name: Official Source Validation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: **No official-source claims without the official source.** The Awwwards 40/30/20/10 weighting appears in no official Awwwards documentation — only in third-party/AI-generated repos.
primitives.assumptions: Only claims backed by official documentation are valid; D ⇒ O.

layer2.mapping: GSE maps documented claims to official source nodes in a knowledge graph; invalidates claims without O.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of claims validated against official sources

primitives.name: Conflict Resolution Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: But when a newer official source contradicts an older figure (Matterport Pro3: your $5,995 vs their current $3,995 FAQ), the official source wins and the stale figure is marked STALE, not kept as equal.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_1, F_2': 'figures from two sources (currency)', 'T_1, T_2': 'timestamps of sources (time)', 'C': 'conflict status (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Newer official source supersedes older; F_1 ≠ F_2 ⇒ C = true.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T_2 > T_1 ∧ C ⇒ F_2 is authoritative

layer2.mapping: GSI applies temporal precedence to resolve conflicting figures; stale data tagged with STALE flag.
layer2.telemetry: Number of resolved conflicts per batch
